sources.notes: 将具身数据时空一致性拆为时钟/采样、坐标/标定、跨视角/跨模态对应、动作—状态因果对齐、长程物理连续性五层；这些术语不会稳定同时出现在论文标题或摘要中。

queries.label: dynamic-clock-sensor-synchronization
queries.query: (all:robot OR all:embodied) AND (all:"sensor synchronization" OR all:"time synchronization" OR all:"timestamp alignment")
queries.why: 覆盖多传感器硬件时钟、时间戳、延迟和抖动讨论。

queries.label: dynamic-multimodal-temporal-alignment
queries.query: all:"robot manipulation" AND (all:"temporal alignment" OR all:"cross-modal alignment") AND (all:tactile OR all:force OR all:vision)
queries.why: 覆盖视觉、触觉、力觉与机器人状态的跨模态时间对齐。

queries.label: dynamic-spatial-calibration-coordinate-frame
queries.query: all:robot AND (all:"coordinate frame" OR all:"spatial calibration" OR all:extrinsic) AND (all:dataset OR all:demonstration OR all:multimodal)
queries.why: 覆盖相机—机器人—物体参考系、外参和空间标定。

queries.label: dynamic-view-consistent-4d-data
queries.query: (all:"view-consistent" OR all:"multi-view consistency") AND (all:4D OR all:"world model") AND all:robot
queries.why: 覆盖跨视角几何一致和任意视角时空生成。

queries.label: dynamic-point-tracks-correspondence
queries.query: (all:"3D point tracks" OR all:"spatiotemporal correspondence") AND (all:manipulation OR all:embodied)
queries.why: 覆盖跨帧点身份、遮挡可见性与度量几何监督。

queries.label: dynamic-action-state-consistency
queries.query: all:robot AND (all:"action-state consistency" OR all:"action observation alignment" OR all:"action-conditioned state")
queries.why: 覆盖动作、观测和状态变化之间的对齐与检核。

queries.label: dynamic-action-fidelity-long-horizon
queries.query: all:"robot world model" AND (all:"action fidelity" OR all:"long-horizon consistency" OR all:"temporal consistency")
queries.why: 覆盖长程预测漂移、动作忠实和视频逼真但物理不一致的反例。

queries.label: dynamic-contact-event-alignment
queries.query: all:"contact-rich manipulation" AND (all:"contact event" OR all:"contact-aware" OR all:"event-driven") AND (all:tactile OR all:force)
queries.why: 覆盖稀疏接触事件、固定帧采样失真和接触门控。

queries.label: dynamic-physical-time-action-chunk
queries.query: (all:VLA OR all:"vision-language-action") AND (all:"action chunk" OR all:"control frequency") AND (all:latency OR all:asynchronous OR all:alignment)
queries.why: 覆盖动作块按物理时长而非固定帧数对齐、控制频率和延迟。

queries.label: dynamic-spatiotemporal-data-quality
queries.query: (all:robot OR all:embodied) AND all:"spatiotemporal consistency" AND (all:data OR all:dataset OR all:trajectory)
queries.why: 直接捕捉明确使用时空一致性术语的数据论文。

browser_fallback_queries.label: dynamic-browser-spatiotemporal-data
browser_fallback_queries.query: site:arxiv.org robot data spatiotemporal consistency synchronization calibration action-state
browser_fallback_queries.why: API 术语过严时补获相邻论文。

web_calibration_queries.label: dynamic-web-physical-time
web_calibration_queries.query: robot dataset physical time alignment sensor clock action chunk
web_calibration_queries.why: 校准论文对物理时间、控制频率和同步误差的实际用词。

web_calibration_queries.label: dynamic-web-spatial-contract
web_calibration_queries.query: robot learning dataset coordinate frame calibration provenance multimodal
web_calibration_queries.why: 校准空间契约、标定谱系和参考系残差术语。
